intro: Covers lessons 1 to 18 of Industry and empire, 1750 to 1900: the Industrial Revolution. Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: The domestic system meant goods were made:
questions.a: B) At home by hand. Before factories, families spun and wove at home: the domestic system.

questions.q: The 1842 Mines Act banned underground work for:
questions.a: B) Women and boys under 10. It stopped women and girls, and boys under 10, working underground.

questions.q: Why were mills built beside the Rochdale Canal?
options: To move coal and cotton cheaply
questions.a: B) To move coal and cotton cheaply. Canals carried heavy coal in and goods out cheaply.

questions.q: Peterloo took place in:
questions.a: B) Manchester, 1819. It happened at St Peter's Field, Manchester, on 16 August 1819.

questions.q: The Crystal Palace was mainly made of:
questions.a: B) Glass and iron. Paxton's design used prefabricated iron and glass panels.
